sentences.text: Atlantic City is a 1980 French-Canadian romantic crime film directed by Louis Malle .	Louis Malle	Louis Malle	French	France	Canadian	Canada
Filmed in late 1979 , it was released in France and Germany in 1980 and in the United States in 1981 .	France	France	Germany	Germany	United States	United States
The script was written by John Guare .	John Guare	John Guare

It stars Burt Lancaster , Susan Sarandon , Kate Reid , Robert Joy , Hollis McLaren , Michel Piccoli , and Al Waxman .	Burt Lancaster	Burt Lancaster	Susan Sarandon	Susan Sarandon	Kate Reid	Kate Reid	Robert Joy	Robert Joy	Hollis McLaren	Hollis McLaren	Michel Piccoli	Michel Piccoli	Al Waxman	Al Waxman

Atlantic City is among the 41 films to be nominated for all `` Big Five '' Academy Awards , including Best Picture , Best Director , Best Actor , Best Actress and Best Screenplay , and one of only eight among this group to not take home a single award .
